What’s bullshit?

US public K-12 funding has jumped 25%+ in real per student spending over the last 20 years.

Yet NAEP scores (Nation’s Report Card) flat for decades, with clear declines in recent years.

More money doesn’t equal results.

Stop playing politics.


Tom Steyer (@TomSteyer)

This is bullshit. I promise you.

Tax billionaires. Invest in schools.



— https://nitter.net/TomSteyer/status/2057107355771256928#m

America needs more of this kind of common sense.

Why should Americans trust politicians with more tax revenue when they already have a track record of wasting the money and failing to solve problems?

Billionaires aren’t the enemy. Bad policies are.


Jeff Bezos (@JeffBezos)
